obfuscation_indicators: could experience fluctuation, volatility and declines
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally precise and well quantified, but reports material deterioration: assets under management fell 16.4%, net outflows reached $6.3 billion, revenue declined 15.2%, and operating income declined 38.5%. Risk is concentrated in investment-market volatility, client outflows, fee-rate pressure, and a sharply higher effective tax rate. Some repeated causal language and broad forward-looking market-risk statements modestly reduce clarity.
